cli.usage_root:
Usage:
  ttv-tui doctor [--lang en|pt-BR]
  ttv-tui [flags]
  ttv-tui login [--from-browser [--browser <name>] [--profile <name>] | --import twt]

Embedded video: set video = "sixel" in config.toml, or use --video=sixel.

Flags:
cli.usage_login:
Usage:
  ttv-tui login --from-browser [--browser <name>] [--profile <name>]
  ttv-tui login --import twt

Flags:
cli.flag.from_browser: extract Twitch auth-token cookie from an installed browser
cli.flag.browser: browser name (brave, chrome, chromium, edge, vivaldi, opera, firefox)
app.err_tty_required: stdin and stdout must be terminals. Run directly in a terminal or use ssh -t.
app.orphan_prompt: A player from a previous session is still running (channel %s, pid %d). Stop it before continuing? [Y/n]
app.orphan_stopped: Player from the previous session stopped.
app.orphan_kept: Player kept running; opening another video will play two audio streams.
app.orphan_cleaned_log: ttv-tui: stopped a player left running by a previous session (channel %s, pid %d)
app.orphan_stop_failed: ttv-tui: could not stop the previous player (pid %d): %v
app.warn_input_conf: ttv-tui: the mpv window ran without keys, its key file could not be written: %v
login.warn_expiry: Warning: token is nearing expiration (expires_in=%ds); once expired, simply run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser'.
login.warn_overwrite: Warning: a token is already saved in the config; it will be replaced.
login.warn_scopes: Warning: token lacks chat scopes (chat_login, chat:edit or chat:read; current scopes: %s); sending messages will not work and you must sign in again via browser.
login.success: Login completed for %s (configuration saved to %s with 0600 permissions).
login.err_empty_token: empty token; log in to twitch.tv and run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser'
login.err_twt_not_found: twitch-tui file not found at %s; configure twt or use 'ttv-tui login --from-browser': %w
login.err_twt_no_token: no token found in %s; check token field or use 'ttv-tui login --from-browser'
login.err_browser_flag_not_found: browser %q not found or has no cookie store; open twitch.tv in a supported browser or run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser'
login.err_profile_flag_not_found: profile %q not found; run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser' without --profile to see available profiles
login.err_no_browsers_found: no supported browser with cookie database found; open twitch.tv in browser and sign in or use 'ttv-tui login --import twt'
login.err_invalid_profile_choice: invalid profile choice %q: enter a number between 1 and %d
login.err_keyring: keyring locked or unavailable: unlock the session keyring (or install libsecret/secret-tool) and try again: %w
login.err_cookie: profile has no twitch.tv cookie: open https://www.twitch.tv in this profile, sign in, and run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser' again: %w
login.err_browser: browser missing or without cookies: open twitch.tv in a supported browser (Brave, Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Vivaldi, Opera or Firefox) or use 'ttv-tui login --import twt': %w
login.err_profile: profile not found: run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser' without --profile to list available profiles: %w
login.err_sqlite: sqlite3 not found in PATH: install the sqlite (sqlite3) package and try again: %w
login.err_token_invalid: token invalid or expired (401): log in again on twitch.tv via browser and run 'ttv-tui login --from-browser': %w
login.err_timeout: timeout validating token at id.twitch.tv: check your internet connection and try again: %w
